newsitem.title: UK: Siemens to launch euro Eurobonds in DEM, FRF, NLG.
newsitem.headline: Siemens to launch euro Eurobonds in DEM, FRF, NLG.

text.p: Siemens AG will shortly issue three Eurobonds simultaneously in French francs, guilders and marks which will each be redenominated in euros after EMU, lead manager J.P. Morgan Securities said on Friday.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will be joint lead manager on all three tranches.
The deals will have a 10-year maturity.
Paribas will also be joint lead on the franc deal and ABN AMRO Hoare Govett will be joint lead on the guilder deal.
The offering will be Aaa/AAA rated Siemens first syndicated fixed income public transaction in more than 25 years, J.P. Morgan said in a statement.
The three deals will be fungible into one euro Eurobond after EMU, J.P. Morgan said.
